# Birthday Card Generator

> Create personalized AI birthday cards in minutes. Choose a style, add your message, and download instantly. No design skills needed.

Birthday Card Generator (https://www.birthdaycardgenerator.com) is a web app for creating unique, AI-generated birthday cards. Pick from four styles (Warm, Funny, Formal, Cute), choose or write a greeting, and get a one-of-a-kind card in under 30 seconds.

## Features
- AI-powered card generation (text-to-image)
- 4 card styles: Warm, Funny, Formal, Cute
- 50+ preset birthday greetings by relationship category
- 1024×1024px PNG download
- Card history dashboard
- Free tier: 3 cards/month
- Pro tier: 30 cards/month, 4K resolution, no watermark
